options.first_line: Costco's membership cards brought in {fees_total} in one year.
options.first_frame: A giant Costco membership card held up at the warehouse entrance under the red COSTCO sign, the figure stamped across the card as shoppers stream in.

options.title: Costco's profit was {profit_total}. The card paid {feeshare_pct} of it
options.first_line: Costco's whole profit last year was {profit_total}, and a plastic card covered {feeshare_pct} of it.
options.first_frame: Inside the warehouse, a towering pallet of cash labelled PROFIT with the figure on its tag, and a membership card the size of a door leaning against it.

options.title: Costco sold {sales_total} of groceries and kept {margin_pct} 🛒
options.first_line: Costco sold {sales_total} of goods in one year and kept only {margin_pct} as profit.
options.first_frame: A huge Costco shopping cart piled high with goods under the warehouse sign, a till receipt unrolling with the sales figure and a tiny profit line circled.

why: A plastic card paying for most of a famous giant's entire profit is the most surprising fact of the three and makes a stranger stay to learn how, and the cash pallet next to a door-sized card says it even on mute.
